title: 第2章 盗梦者。
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

司陇第一反应是电脑摄像头被自动

她在椅子上坐立难安，朝着房间里四处看去，似乎想搜索出什么可疑物品。

摄像头？监视器？

什么都没有。

她小小的出租屋内并没有繁杂的东西，除了乱七八糟的衣服以外，一张床一个衣柜一张电脑桌就是全部。

极简到不能再简的打工社畜原始人小屋。

难道自己之前有不小心提交过个人照片到这个游戏的论坛里？

但这个想法很快就被她否了。

因为屏幕上生成的人物穿着，正是自己现在这套睡衣。

带着蕾丝边的淡黄色宽松睡裙，胸口还印着一个hellokitty。

乱糟糟的头发，和一个大大的黑框眼镜。

甚至连黑眼圈都是一模一样的。

搞什么啊这游戏，这种泄露玩家隐私的行为也太让人生气了。

她试图在人物形象旁边找到删除，或者是重新生成之类的按键，却发现根本没有任何可操作的地方。

但却在人物形象旁边发现一个小标签，上面有三个凸起的字。

【盗梦者】

这难道是游戏里的某种职业吗。

司陇现在来不及细想这个，迅速搜索点开了永夜梦主的游戏论坛。

她现在急需知道像她这样的隐私泄露的情况是否是个例。

但她第一眼却被论坛右上角的数字吸引。

【10000】

血红色的字体，甚至做了动态渗血特效，旁边写着已成功注册玩家。

怎么会刚好就10000个人呢，是不是弄错了。

胳膊上的鸡皮疙瘩忽然浮起，周身莫名感到一丝凉气。

司陇点开了一个标题为【个人隐私泄露！我要投诉！！】的帖子。

“有人知道这游戏怎么回事吗？为啥我成了自己的角色形象？”

“没事哒没事哒，幸好我今天准备出门约会，早早就化好了妆~”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Si Long's first reaction was that the computer camera was automatically

She fidgeted in her chair and looked around the room, as if she wanted to search for something suspicious.

Camera?Monitor?

Nothing.

There are no complicated things in her small rental house. Except for the messy clothes, there is only a bed, a wardrobe and a computer desk.

A minimalist hut for primitive people working as a working community animal.

Have you ever accidentally submitted your personal photos to this game’s forum before?

But this idea was quickly rejected by her.

Because the character generated on the screen is wearing the same pajamas that I am wearing now.

A light yellow loose nightgown with lace edges and a hellokitty printed on the chest.

Messy hair and big black-rimmed glasses.

Even the dark circles under his eyes are exactly the same.

What the hell is this game doing? This kind of leaking of player privacy is so annoying.

She tried to find the delete or regenerate buttons next to the character image, but found that there was no action at all.

But I found a small label next to the character with three raised characters on it.

【Dream Stealer】

Is this some kind of profession in the game?

Si Long didn't have time to think about this, so he quickly searched and opened the game forum of Yongye Dream Lord.

She now urgently needs to know whether privacy breaches like hers are the exception.

But at first glance, she was attracted by the numbers in the upper right corner of the forum.

【10000】

The blood-red font even had dynamic bleeding effects, and next to it it said that the player has been successfully registered.

How come there are exactly 10,000 people? Is it a mistake?

The goosebumps on my arms suddenly appeared, and I felt an inexplicable chill all over my body.

Si Long clicked on a message titled [Personal privacy leaked!I want to complain!!]'s post.

"Does anyone know what's going on in this game? Why did I become my own avatar?"

"It's okay, it's okay. Fortunately, I'm going out on a date today, so I put on my makeup early~"
